E2702

Crypto API misuse

What

Crypto API misuse

Why

{why}

Fix

{fix}

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2702: tests/ui/crypto_release_entropy_seam.stderr.

Error [E2702]: crypto API misuse
  --> tests/ui/crypto_release_entropy_seam.jet:5:53
    |
  5 |     _ :: crypto.password_hash_with_salt("password", [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7])
    |                                                     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `password_hash_with_salt` would use caller-controlled salt bytes, which makes a deterministic entropy seam reachable from a release build
 Fix: use `crypto.password_hash` so Jet generates the salt, or move a fixed vector to `expert.argon2id` inside `#Unsafe`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E2702
